mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread aimed at other diesel builders about King main thrust bearings. Title itself is a warning, which makes it the most damaging framing of any thread on the list.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: BMW owner reports King thrust bearings measuring over 1mm too narrow to fit the block. A dimensional defect on a fitted part, with clear warranty implications.
mentions.replyNote: Still 307-redirects to the tollbit.m5board.com mirror instead of returning thread content, same as the previous check.

mentions.title: No more King XP bearings
mentions.snippet: Builders report a 2024 King main bearing out of spec on free spread and a second bad 2025 main bearing, raising repeat manufacturing-process concerns. King has since posted an official reply in the thread.
mentions.replyNote: A King representative posted an official response acknowledging the older thread, addressing the bearing wall thickness concerns and offering to investigate specific parts.

mentions.title: King Bearing Failures?
mentions.snippet: Main and rod bearings reported destroyed during initial startup and break-in of a new engine. Some commenters suggest other build factors may have contributed.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: Customer received a sealed King XP package with wrong shell quantities and says King declined to send replacement halves, redirecting him to the supplier. Complaint is about service handling as much as the part.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: Builder received an SI bi-metal main shell malformed in production, crushed and twisted, giving a poor fit in the block. Single credible defect report with photos-style detail.
